setup: CREATE TABLE t AS SELECT i FROM range(50000) t(i); CREATE TABLE keyed(i BIGINT PRIMARY KEY); INSERT INTO keyed SELECT i FROM range(50000) t(i); CREATE TABLE u AS SELECT i FROM range(32) u(i)

workloads.name: filter
workloads.sql: SELECT i FROM t WHERE i%2=0

workloads.name: point
workloads.sql: SELECT i FROM keyed WHERE i=25000

workloads.name: correlated_exists
workloads.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM t WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM u WHERE u.i=t.i%64)

workloads.name: recursive_linear
workloads.sql: WITH RECURSIVE r(i) AS (SELECT 0::BIGINT UNION ALL SELECT i+1 FROM r WHERE i<999) SELECT count(*),sum(i) FROM r

workloads.name: recursive_cycle
workloads.sql: WITH RECURSIVE r(i) AS (SELECT 0::BIGINT UNION SELECT (i+1)%257 FROM r) SELECT i FROM r

workloads.name: recursive_correlated
workloads.sql: SELECT (WITH RECURSIVE r(i) AS (SELECT j UNION ALL SELECT i+1 FROM r WHERE i<j+8) SELECT sum(i) FROM r) FROM range(16) x(j)

workloads.name: alter_add_column
workloads.sql: ALTER TABLE t ADD COLUMN added BIGINT DEFAULT 7
workloads.reset: ALTER TABLE t DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS added

workloads.name: alter_drop_column
workloads.sql: ALTER TABLE t DROP COLUMN added
workloads.reset: ALTER TABLE t ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS added BIGINT DEFAULT 7

workloads.name: alter_rename_table
workloads.sql: ALTER TABLE t RENAME TO renamed
workloads.reset: ALTER TABLE IF EXISTS renamed RENAME TO t
